final_draft.answer: Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) need two approving reviews before they can be merged. The rule applies to administrators as well.
final_draft.note: The approved answer (CC8.1, valid until 2027-11-18) gives this wording. A live check of GitHub at 2026-11-18T03:39:40Z backed it up: the main branch of harborlight/app is protected, needs 2 approving reviews, and the rule applies to administrators. Both sources cover only the harborlight/app repository. We have no source for other repositories, so a reviewer should confirm the question isn't asking about them.

arguments.query: code review approvals before merge to main branch

answer:887b5ac7-4455-44f7-8632-9b58bcfce: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:c8e8a73e-f210-417d-a5f1-d79c2b61d: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:64213a48-6faa-4708-b19e-49aa8144f: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:c5e013f4-6838-42e1-92be-bcfe1cdb6: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:7abd19ec-2c32-452c-be8f-da5cb7000: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
evidence:e01d628c-104e-4b50-9131-9883291: Branch main of harborlight/app is protected: a change needs 2 approving reviews before it can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators. Observed 2026-11-18 03:39 UTC.
